content.short: Asterizm is a plug-and-play blockchain interoperability solution for enterprises and Web3 protocols.
content.description: Asterizm enables web3 developers and corporate clients to design cross-chain dApps that leverage the strengths of multiple blockchains while keeping their server infrastructure secure, staying compliant with regulations, and avoiding data-leak risks. It secures cross-chain transactions with the on-chain Asterizm Connector, which checks the validity and integrity of cross-chain activity, and is complemented by two independent off-chain components: Asterizm Relayers, which transfer proofs of cross-chain transactions, and a client off-chain module deployed by the customer to transmit payload data.
